Cors.//: Origins the browser is allowed to call this API from. Scheme + host only — no path, no trailing slash; CorsPolicy.ResolveOrigins refuses to start otherwise, because ASP.NET Core would accept a path here and then silently match nothing. Not a secret, so it lives in version control where a reviewer can see it rather than in a dashboard nobody reads. Override per environment with Cors__AllowedOrigins__0.
